brief:
Pro-Palestine demonstrators gathered outside Ed Sheeran's solo concert in Philadelphia, Al Jazeera English reported. The protest marked the latest in a series of activist actions targeting cultural events amid escalating tensions over the Gaza conflict.

Details of the protest size, duration, and specific demands were not immediately available. Pro-Palestine groups have staged demonstrations at multiple high-profile events in recent weeks.
dek: Pro-Palestine protesters rallied outside Ed Sheeran’s solo concert in Philadelphia.
title: Pro-Palestine protesters rally outside Ed Sheeran concert in Philadelphia
